meta.cheats: Using a cheat disables trophies and saving, so keep cheats off the whole trophy run.
meta.saves: 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of each of the 5 chapters.
meta.note: Trophy names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags are the official list as carried by Exophase and PSNProfiles (list live 18 Nov 2026, a day before launch). Guide steps are written in our own words from the published guides cited on each trophy. Four trophies have no confirmed trigger in any published guide as of 20 Nov 2026 and say so plainly instead of inventing a method.

roadmap.title: Stage 1: Play the story, guard the one missable
roadmap.text: Play the five chapters and enjoy the campaign. No mission needs a gold medal and there are no difficulty settings. Along the way, scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study every new animal through binoculars; you will need 200 base-model vehicles and 100 animals for the 100% checklist later, and collecting them now saves hours of cleanup. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 slots, no mission replay). The one thing you must not miss: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not confirmed whether Positive Mental Attitude needs it, so do not skip it.

roadmap.title: Stage 2: The 100% checklist
roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Everything you did before already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It is closer to 60% true completion: most things only need a share (100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 100 WAiNK scans), but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's target decks are required in full. Do robberies first, then collectibles, then activities. Most of the miscellaneous trophies pop along the way.

roadmap.title: Stage 3: Strangers and Freaks and the questlines
roadmap.text: Stranger missions are not part of 100%, but Strangers & Freaks needs 8 qualifying strands, and not every questline counts, so check the trophy's progress counter instead of counting contacts. Finish the character questlines for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret, plus Cal's fishing challenge. One caution: a report says the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 might cost you a strand if skipped, so do it the moment it appears.

roadmap.title: Stage 4: Secrets, combat and cleanup
roadmap.text: The last stretch is the hidden secret trophies, the combat and robbery trophies, and the money ones. Four of the secrets have no confirmed trigger in any published guide yet. This guide says so plainly rather than inventing a method, so check back for those. When the last trophy pops, Vice Got a Price! follows automatically.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; this one pops automatically the moment the last one pops.
There is no separate task. It is the reward for finishing the whole list.
Budget around 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, the first mission of Chapter 1.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops at the end. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Play through Chapter 1 to the end.
The trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 begins, after the mission What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play through Chapter 2 to the end.
It is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after Welcome to Vice City.
trophies.note: The name is censored as shown in the published lists.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play through Chapter 3 to the end.
It arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Play through Chapter 4 to the end.
The trophy pops when the chapter closes. It cannot be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the final story mission.
Free roam continues after the credits, so everything else on this list can be cleaned up afterwards.
There is no mission replay, but no trophy depends on how you play a mission.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.
Finish it; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Finish the heist; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Finish it; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play Headliners in Chapter 4.
Finish it; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Finish it; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Finish it; the trophy pops at the end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story first. The 100% checklist only appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the credits, but everything you did before already counts.

Robberies first: all 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, all 8 bank vaults, 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, 50 of 91 stick ups, $100,000 narcotics, $100,000 jewelry, $250,000 marked bills and $200,000 vehicles fenced.

Collectibles next: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, all 33 underwater discoveries, 30 of 34 magazines/books/comics, 15 of 18 meditations, 100 of 125 cocaine flamingos, 2 unique playlists, 70 of 79 styles, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, 50 of 66 standard weapons and 100 of 255 animals studied.

Activities last: 30 of 40 races won, 10 of 13 race golds, all 42 shooting range golds, all 4 video games, 5 of 7 pool opponents, mini golf at 2 of 3 spots, 90 of 100 basketball hoops, all 42 drone time trials, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, all 15 of Bret's target decks and 100 optional missions.
You only need a share of most things. The checklist is closer to 60% true completion, but robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's decks are required in full.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, and 70 of 80 challenges means you can skip the 10 hardest.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the fastest way to add to the count; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed.
Check the count under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and use the map to show every Stunt Spot.
Keep going to 300. The 100% checklist wants 300, not 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.desc: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities to see what is left. Most of them come naturally while you play.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.desc: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge, 42 golds across 12 ranges.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.
The 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so there is no way around them.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.desc: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for this trophy.
The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finish each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from.
Winning the same race again does not count. It has to be 20 different ones.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 won, so keep racing.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.desc: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui.
After that he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon.
Play through his fishing quests, then beat him in his challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Reach the end of any one arcade game.
Three of them (Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind) are on the TV at home; the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville.
Do all five in order: Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Kenton (green KR icon in Key Lento) hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks.
Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up.
He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
Work through all five; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, pops the trophy.
They stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.desc: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list rather than guessing.
None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.
Watch out: one report says the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 might cost you a strand if skipped, so do it the moment it appears.
trophies.note: Possible second missable (Race Against Yago) is unconfirmed. Treat it as a watch item, not a confirmed missable.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS).
Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon).
Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look.
Cars in better condition pay more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.desc: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City.
Once enough are gone, his last job (Shut Down the Labs) awards the trophy.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.desc: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; there are 18 spots in 10 locations.
Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice.
The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.

Do this before you leave Chapter 1. The morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do not skip it.
trophies.note: The only confirmed possibly-missable trophy in the list.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.desc: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off.
Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason.
A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet. The 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway, so finish them all.
trophies.note: The trigger animal is not confirmed in any published guide yet.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them.
The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.
The 100% checklist wants 15 of 18 sets, so you will likely finish this on the way.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB).
Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.
Vehicle scanning is a separate objective. These are environmental locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick.
Many complete themselves while you play.
The 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.desc: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Possible once both characters are together (after Coffee Break in Chapter 2).
Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape.
It only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. Clearing the flashing search area is not enough.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well.
Bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often pops there.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.desc: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue).
Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items.
The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3) are close together.
The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.
Staying inside the red heat zone without an active Wanted Level does not count. The pursuit has to stay active between shops.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them.
Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic.
The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.desc: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming).
It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first (eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer) and use an assault rifle.
Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.desc: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge (planes parked out on the airfield do not count).
Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport.
Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County (the tanks are at the south end of the base).
Take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.desc: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun.
Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door (kicking it in sets off the alarm).
Find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….
Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open.
The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner.
Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles.
5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.
Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.desc: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Robbing a bank vault (see Maximum Withdrawal) counts, as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray.
Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida.
The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.desc: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count.
The 100% checklist needs all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.desc: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.note: No confirmed trigger in any published guide as of 20 Nov 2026. The description points to having a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach, but no guide has confirmed the exact steps, so do not trust a method you see elsewhere until one is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.desc: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.note: No confirmed trigger in any published guide as of 20 Nov 2026. The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, but no guide has confirmed the exact steps.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.desc: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2.
Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs).
The trophy pops once you lose the police.
You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason and Lucia, then Strength, in the pause menu).
Work out at fitness clubs (Map, then Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too.
After the story you can also train at home.
trophies.note: The exact condition is still provisional in published guides. The reported method is maxing Strength for both characters.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Do 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile.
Most players get it without trying; robberies and enemy encounters count.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings, then UI, to watch the count.
Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.note: No confirmed trigger in any published guide as of 20 Nov 2026. The description (Second time's the charm) suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt, but that is only a reading of the words. No guide has confirmed the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.note: No confirmed trigger in any published guide as of 20 Nov 2026. The description (What the hell just happened?) suggests a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida, but no guide has confirmed what it is.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.desc: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Knock people down with a melee attack from a vehicle, a melee drive-by, as the description says.
The precise method is still being confirmed in published guides, so expect the details to be refined. The trigger itself is the melee drive-by.
trophies.note: Precise method still being confirmed (KeenGamer, GTABase). The description gives the trigger.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.desc: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
It is a running total of $250,000, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend a running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop.
Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total.
The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.
Reserve the money before spending freely on clothes, hair or tattoos. You need the garage space for On the Spot too.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.desc: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app.
Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them.
At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones.
You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.
